alignments.note: Finite verb takes its auxiliary and lexical verb (rule 17); up kept with the verb as the phrasal particle of the ASV's fixed rendering swallow up for שָׁאַף (rule 44, as at AMO.8.4 and v. 1), since bare swallow is not the ASV's word for this lexeme. Competing reading: up added as a surplus particle. Discontinuous around the supplied object (rule 25).

Noun takes enemies; the supplied they of the later verbless clause resumes this nominal, which stands earlier in the verse, so it joins the noun's discontinuous unit under rule 25, headed on the lexeme-bearing word. Margin 'They that lie in wait for me' read and set aside (rule 38).
כֹּל takes all only, as in vv. 1 and 5; long belongs to יוֹם.

The ASV's idiomatic day long realizes the noun; long is the English spent on the duration the noun states and joins it (rule 31), headed on day, as in vv. 1 and 5 and the corpus's 8 'day long' units. Competing readings: long on כֹּל, or added under rule 2.
Substantival adjective made the predicate of the ASV's recast clause; construction-supplied copula are joins it (rule 20), headed on many.

Articleless participle standing after the nominal it modifies, recast by the ASV as a relative clause: the relative stays with the attributive (rule 41), headed on fight. Competing reading: לֹחֲמִים as the clause's predicate with that added under rule 55.
Adverbial accusative מָרוֹם '(on) high' rendered as the adverb proudly; the noun's whole rendering (rule 33).
Object pronoun supplied for a verb that writes no object morpheme and no marker (rule 44); not a resumption (rule 25).

review_notes: ASV recasts רַבִּים לֹחֲמִים לִי מָרוֹם as 'they are many that fight proudly against me'; the supplied 'they' is given to שׁוֹרְרַי as a resumed nominal under rule 25 rather than marked added.

'all the day long': 'long' placed on יוֹם as 'day long', matching vv. 1 and 5 and the corpus (8 units headed on day); giving it to כֹּל was the verse pass's original reading, reversed at reconciliation.
